news.title: France wants to transform Fifa after withdrawing Infantino support
news.lede: The French Football Federation announced its support for Infantino in June, before the investment plan was announced. France's football leaders have proposed to seek ways to transform how Fifa is run after its national association became the latest to withdraw support for Gianni Infantino's presidency. On Thursday, the French Football Federation (FFF) followed England, Italy, Republic of Ireland and Scotland in withdrawing support for Infantino over his aborted plan to sell stakes in Fifa competitions - including the World Cup - to private investors. The FFF had pledged its support for Infantino in June before his investment proposal came to light.

news.title: 2030 FIFA World Cup final up for grabs as Morocco, Spain fight for hosting rights
news.lede: Morocco and Spain are locked in a high-stakes contest to host the 2030 World Cup final, with FIFA yet to officially decide the venue for football’s showpiece. The 2030 World Cup final will be held in Casablanca, the President of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation was reported as saying by Spanish news agency EFE on Thursday. Soccer's world governing body FIFA has yet to announce the venue of the final, with Spain and Morocco in a heated battle to host soccer's biggest showpiece match. "The province of Benslimane will have the honour of hosting the 2030 World Cup final," Fouzi Lekjaa told a political party event in Bouznika, Morocco on Thursday, EFE reported.

news.title: French Football Federation Withdraws Support For FIFA President Infantino
news.lede: The French Football Federation is withdrawing its support for Gianni Infantino's reelection bid as head of FIFA ‌next year, FFF President Philippe Diallo said on Thursday. Several European federations, including England's and Italy's, have withdrawn their backing for Infantino since the collapse ‌of ⁠his proposed World Cup stake sale. UEFA, the Asian Football Confederation and North America's CONCACAF have called for change at the top ⁠of FIFA and are seeking a credible alternative ahead of the March election. Infantino still has ⁠the support of South America's CONMEBOL and Africa's CAF.

news.title: Lekjaa Says Benslimane Will Host 2030 World Cup Final, Hopes for Morocco-France Clash
news.lede: Casablanca – Fouzi Lekjaa, member of the Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM) Political Bureau and President of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF), said the province will have the honor of hosting the 2030 World Cup final at the Hassan II Stadium. Speaking at an electoral gathering in Benslimane Province, Lekjaa told the crowd, “What you need to know is that Benslimane Province will have the honor of hosting the 2030 World Cup final.” He said the prospect would place development of the province high on the agenda of the government that will take office after the upcoming legislative elections. Whoever serves in the next government will have no option but to develop Benslimane Province,” Lekjaa said.

news.title: Lekjaa announces it before FIFA: Morocco will host the 2030 World Cup final
news.lede: Great Moroccan confidence in settling the race with SpainMorocco have raised the bar in the race to host the 2030 World Cup final. Fouzi Lekjaa, president of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation, has confirmed that the Grand Stade Hassan II in Benslimane will stage the tournament's showpiece, even though FIFA are yet to name the venue for the match.Lekjaa spoke at an Authenticity and Modernity Party event in the city of Bouznika, where he backed Morocco to settle the battle over the tournament's biggest game with striking confidence.As highlighted by the Spanish newspaper " Sport ", the president of the Moroccan federation said: "What you need to know is that the province of Benslimane will have the honour of hosting the 2030 World Cup final." He went further still, picturing the two finalists and wishing for Morocco to meet France.
